meaning.en: Third-person singular simple present indicative form of gam.

sentences.en: Beauties like Gams don't come around very often.

sentences.en: The dresses that are long in the back but short in the front give girls with great gams a way to show them off without appearing too informal.

sentences.en: Keeping their gams in shape while working stilettos and couture gowns is just one of the many jobs a celebrity must be committed to do in order to look her absolute best.

sentences.en: Celebrity gams are often enhanced with a great pair of heels and a killer pair of jeans.

sentences.en: While the perfect pair of legs may be defined differently by different people, the celebrities listed below are generally regarded as having a great pair of gams.

sentences.en: While statuesque beauties may find it easier to land on a best legs list, some petite celebrities are also listed due to their shapely gams.
sentences.vi: Trong khi những người đẹp như tượng có thể dễ dàng lọt vào danh sách những đôi chân đẹp nhất, thì một số người nổi tiếng nhỏ nhắn cũng được xếp vào danh sách do những gam màu quyến rũ của họ.

sentences.en: It's tough deciding who should be inducted into a hall of fame dedicated to great legs, as everyone has his own opinion of what constitutes hall-worthy gams.

sentences.en: A v-neck will draw attention to your upper body, while flared, embellished skirts on baby dolls and chemises will shine the spotlight on a great pair of gams.

sentences.en: A dress with an above-the-knee hemline will show your gams off to your best advantage, in a classy, polished manner.
